token.name: AGNAmuse
token.note: Final params picked by agnarez 2026-11-18: name AGNAmuse, symbol AGNA, max total supply 404T (404,000,000,000,000), fixed supply minted once, no mint function. Pool: create on Sepolia after deploy (only chain with a verified V2 DEX); LP tokens to owner, withdrawable. Vanity addresses: pattern to be confirmed (0xa69...).
token.poolNote: Pool funding rule (agnarez, FINAL 2026-11-18): the token deploys PER CHAIN, each chain minting its own 404T. Each chain's pool pairs AGNA with that chain's native gas token (ETH Sepolia/Robinhood, USDC Arc, zkLTC LitVM). Per chain: gas side 40.4% of the wallet's native-gas balance (Sepolia 0.0202 ETH, Arc 32.32 USDC, LitVM 0.0202 zkLTC, Robinhood 0.00406 ETH); AGNA side 99% of that chain's burner AGNA after the 10% agent allocation (~360T per chain; ~3.6T stays with the burner). Per-chain pool numbers: Sepolia ~360T AGNA + 0.0202 ETH; Arc ~360T + 32.32 USDC; LitVM ~360T + 0.0202 zkLTC; Robinhood ~360T + 0.00406 ETH. poolAgnaFractionBps 9900 = 99% of the LIVE AGNA balance at pool time. Agent allocation (10%): sent to the Circle agent wallet only on chains where it exists (Sepolia/Arc/Base Sepolia, chains.<id>.agentWallet); on Robinhood/LitVM it STAYS with the burner — never sent to an address nobody controls there. LP tokens go to the burner (owner), removable/withdrawable, never locked/burned. Pools open per chain only once a DEX/router is verified on that chain — Sepolia first.
